user.title: Share the boat's track on noforeignland
user.description: Positions are kept through internet outages and sent when the connection returns. Nothing is sent before the first position is logged.

data_description.source: A device tracker, for example Vigie's own boat
data_description.boat_key: On noforeignland's website: Account → Settings → Boat tracking → API Key
data_description.integration_key: Leave empty: noforeignland's key for this integration is built in. Fill it in only if noforeignland gave you a key of your own.
Leave empty: noforeignland's key for this integration is built in. Fill it in only if noforeignland gave you a key of your own.

error.integration_key: The integration key is a UUID, like 0f8fad5b-d9cb-469f-a165-70867728950e
error.integration_key_needed: This version does not include noforeignland's key yet: enter an integration key

rejected.title: noforeignland refused {title}'s track
rejected.description: noforeignland answered: {message}. Sending is stopped and the positions are kept. Check the boat API key and the integration key (the entry's ⋮ → Reconfigure); sending starts again after that, or after a reload.
